name: PivotHeiken 3
summary: This EA combines Pivot Point levels with Heiken Ashi candlestick analysis to generate trade signals. It identifies entry opportunities when Heiken Ashi candles confirm direction near pivot support/resistance levels, and manages trades with take profit and stop loss based on pivot structure. The strategy aims to capture reversals or breakouts at key pivot levels confirmed by Heiken Ashi trend direction.
summary_zh: 该EA结合支点（Pivot Point）水平与平均K线（Heiken Ashi）分析来生成交易信号。当Heiken Ashi蜡烛在支点支撑/阻力位附近确认方向时，识别入场机会，并基于支点结构设定止盈止损来管理交易。该策略旨在捕捉由Heiken Ashi趋势方向确认的支点关键位反转或突破。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于传统支点计算（每日开盘、最高、最低、收盘价）得出支撑S1/S2/S3和阻力R1/R2/R3水平，结合Heiken Ashi平滑蜡烛图判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当价格接近支点支撑位且Heiken Ashi蜡烛由红转绿时做多，当价格接近支点阻力位且Heiken Ashi蜡烛由绿转红时做空。出场条件包括基于支点距离的固定止盈止损，以及Heiken Ashi颜色反转时的信号出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在相邻支点水平之外，以确保风险可控。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖支点位的准确性及Heiken Ashi在震荡市中的假信号过滤能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on traditional pivot point calculations using daily open, high, low, and close prices to derive support S1/S2/S3 and resistance R1/R2/R3 levels, combined with Heiken Ashi smoothed candles for trend direction confirmation. Entry conditions: go long when price approaches pivot support and Heiken Ashi candles turn from red to green; go short when price approaches pivot resistance and Heiken Ashi candles turn from green to red. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss based on pivot level distances, plus signal exits when Heiken Ashi color reverses. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. Money management sets stop losses beyond adjacent pivot levels to ensure risk is controlled. The overall strategy logic is clear but depends on pivot level accuracy and Heiken Ashi's ability to filter false signals in choppy markets.

pros: 支点与Heiken Ashi双重确认，减少假信号
基于市场关键支撑阻力位交易，逻辑合理
支点水平每日自动更新，适应市场变化
pros_en: Double confirmation with Pivot Points and Heiken Ashi reduces false signals
Trading based on key market support/resistance levels is logically sound
Pivot levels auto-update daily, adapting to market changes
cons: 震荡行情中Heiken Ashi频繁变色导致假信号过多
固定止盈止损未考虑ATR等波动性指标，可能不适配所有市场环境
缺乏多时间框架确认，单周期分析可能错过大趋势
cons_en: Heiken Ashi frequent color changes in choppy markets generate too many false signals
Fixed TP/SL doesn't consider volatility indicators like ATR, may not suit all market conditions
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single timeframe analysis may miss major trends
improvements: 加入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整
增加多时间框架支点确认，如H4和D1支点共振时才入场
加入成交量或RSI过滤器，减少震荡市中的虚假交易信号
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for volatility-adaptive adjustment
Add multi-timeframe pivot confirmation, entering only when H4 and D1 pivots align
Add volume or RSI filter to reduce false trade signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 固定止损可能在大波动行情中被轻易触发
缺乏最大回撤控制或账户级别风险限制
震荡市中信号频繁反转可能导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss can be easily triggered in high volatility conditions
Lacks maximum drawdown control or account-level risk limits
Frequent signal reversals in ranging markets may lead to consecutive losses
